title: Sheafification commutes with slice restriction on sieve sites
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$ given by covering sieves: a sieve is a set of arrows with common target closed under precomposition, the maximal sieve covers, and covering sieves are stable under pullback of sieves and satisfy transitivity. No fibre products in $\mathcal C$ or subcanonicity are assumed. Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $T$ be an object. On $\mathcal C/T$ a sieve on $(S\to T)$ covers if its underlying sieve of arrows to $S$ covers in $J$. Let $\mathcal V$ be sets, abelian groups, rings, or modules over a fixed commutative ring, in universes where the small limits and sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] exist. For every $\mathcal V$-valued presheaf $P$ on $\mathcal C$ there is a canonical natural isomorphism $$ (P|_{\mathcal C/T})^\#\ \cong\ (P^\#)|_{\mathcal C/T}. $$ Here restriction evaluates $P$ on $(S\to T)$ as $P(S)$. The composite of the slice sheafification unit with this isomorphism is the restriction of the original sheafification unit. The isomorphism is natural in all maps of presheaves.
